dz: 反叛的男爵们放弃了对英格兰国王约翰的效忠——这是导致"大宪章"签署的一系列事件的一部分.
de: Rebel barons renounce their allegiance to King John of England — part of a chain of events leading to the signing of the Magna Carta.

dz: 当时在女真统治者金宣宗统治下的中都（今北京）被成吉思汗领导下的蒙古人占领，结束了中都之战。
de: Zhongdu (now Beijing), then under the control of the Jurchen ruler Emperor Xuanzong of Jin, is captured by the Mongols under Genghis Khan, ending the Battle of Zhongdu.

t: 英格兰国王约翰将他的封号加在了"大宪章"上.
te: King John of England puts his seal to Magna Carta.
dz: 英格兰国王约翰将他的封号加在了"大宪章"上.
de: King John of England puts his seal to Magna Carta.

t: 教宗英诺森三世发布一头公牛宣布"大宪章"无效.
te: Pope Innocent III issues a bull declaring Magna Carta invalid.
dz: 教宗英诺森三世发布一头公牛宣布"大宪章"无效.
de: Pope Innocent III issues a bull declaring Magna Carta invalid.

dz: 莱达人第四次理事会开会,界定了通证学说,即面包和葡萄酒根据该学说被说成会变成基督的身体和血液的过程.
de: The Fourth Council of the Lateran meets, defining the doctrine of transubstantiation, the process by which bread and wine are, by that doctrine, said to transform into the body and blood of Christ.
